reason: MailMessage.Body/IsHtmlBody are kept but silently ignored by both the SMTP and Azure providers now (which only read TextBody/HtmlBody), so any external module or site code that still sets Body/IsHtmlBody directly (only marked [Obsolete], not removed) will compile fine but silently send emails with an empty body.
